_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night B=Bedtime. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'. No times = M,A,E,N: Bedtime must be listed

move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, radius} / {pattern, speed, box: [w, h]} for random_wander, or {pattern: route, speed, mode: loop|pingpong, steps: [{to: [dx, dy], speed?} | {wait: s, idle?}]} (draw routes with E in the F placement tool)
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.
CALENDAR opens day 1, authored through 13, then loops day 13 for ever: from day 13
the hall is the receptionist and whichever Card Elders are still to be beaten. Once
all three are beaten the Elders (beaten ones too) leave for good -- on the NEXT visit,
never under the player's feet straight after the winning match.
THE CARD ELDER CHALLENGE starts on day 6 (2026-11-12: pushed back from day 4, every
Elder day in this file +2). Days 2-5 the Elders wander Celeste
Harbour (Super Elder Hamish/Rayne/Waverly in Celeste_Harbour.json). Day 6 Morning
and Afternoon they are busy NPCs behind the three card mats (CardMat/2/3) with the
Plaza Challenger crowd queuing in front; from Evening 6 they battle M,A,E,N.
REGISTRATION opens on day 3 (MapManager REGISTRATION_OPEN_DAY): before that the
receptionist says she is closed (REGISTRAR_CLOSED*).
Beating an Elder swaps them for their '<name> Defeated' NPC (no rematch). Once the
Gym Challenge is complete (flag gym_challenge_complete) all of them leave this
room and move upstairs into the TCG club (TownHall_Upstairs.json).
Evening 6 to day 12 the Town Hall Spectators (1-24) watch from the sides and back,
a big crowd on days 6-9 thinning to one or two by day 12, then none.
WHO IS PLAYING WHICH ELDER is decided in code (Town_Hall_Crowd.gd), not here: each
slot with a spectator puts one 'Elder Challenger N' on an Elder's challenger spot
(Hamish 399,83.5 / Rayne 271,83.5 / Waverly 335,83.5) and that Elder is busy. ANY
character placed here on one of those spots (Ellie, Olly, Alexander...) is playing
that Elder too and locks them out for the slot.
TOWN HALL SECURITY appears once the Gym Challenge is complete: blocking the stairs
until the player buys club membership (flag town_hall_club_member, sold by the
receptionist -- MapManager CLUB_* lines), then standing beside them. Town_Hall.gd
owns the rope and the stair collision and moves the guard aside live on payment.
